upload.title: Inside Walmart's 25 MPH Robot Warehouse #shorts
upload.description:
Walmart is putting Symbotic's AI robotics system into all 42 of its regional distribution centers. Pallets in, robots sort every case, and pallets come out arranged by store aisle.

Full documentary on the channel: The Machine Behind Walmart.
upload.comment: Full documentary (with sources) is on the channel: The Machine Behind Walmart.
